user.title: Connect to the Kindle Dashboard renderer
user.description: The renderer is the *Kindle Dashboard Renderer* app (add-on). The device token is what you put into `config.sh` on the Kindle; it protects `{image_path}` and `{status_path}`.

data.addon_token: Renderer server token (if set in the app options)

data_description.addon_url: Base URL of the renderer app, e.g. http://local-kindledash:8080 or http://<hash>-kindledash:8080.
data_description.device_token: Generated for you; copy it to the Kindle. At least 8 characters.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the renderer at this URL.
error.invalid_auth: The renderer rejected the server token.
error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

render.name: Render now
